doc.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His son Graham and daughter Leslie
summary: Graham is signed to Polygram and Leslie's husband, saxophonist Randy Gilmore, works with gospel groups.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: A chip off the old block.

He says he’s now signed with Polygram. He’s doing good. He’s spending a lot of time in Paris. He’s in New York right now, though. Then my daughter, my great daughter who takes care of all of us, Leslie.
She married a saxophonist. He plays saxophone, but he’s mostly – he plays – he been playing with some of the doo-wop groups.
Randy. Randy Gilmore. He does writing, arranging, and all that stuff too, for some gospel groups.
But they’re right here. He based, what? In Queens, right?

Yeah. He lives in Queens. But I think he’s associated with a church now in Brooklyn where – with a music segment of the church. Plus I think he was in Washington last week where the Cadillacs got some Hall of Fame thing. He was there for that. Leslie went also. She was very excited about going down there, meeting all the people that knew me. So it’s almost a family affair.
